name: Future Navy Pilot T-Shirt
description: Are you ready to shoot for the stars? Show the 'verse that you're on the way to being the best of the best: a pilot of the UEE Navy. In addition to the message emblazoned on the front, this show-stopping t-shirt features an all-over image of a blue and white nebula, the seal of the UEE Navy, and the Invictus logo.
